note: g_Cities has no Exit/Link array. WASM has SearchRoad/GetRoundSelfCity/AttackCityRoad but they are not exported to JS. Edges are computed at runtime from g_CityPositions: connect city index pairs whose Chebyshev distance is 0 or 1. This is a verified tile-neighbor subset, not a full march-range mesh. Do not replace with a guessed complete graph.
